settings.title: How long does delivery take?
settings.text: Free tracked shipping on every US order. Items stocked in US warehouses typically arrive in 2–6 business days; internationally stocked items typically arrive in 10–15 business days.

settings.title: What does shipping cost?
settings.text: Nothing — shipping is free on every US order, with no minimum. It shows as $0.00 at checkout.

settings.title: Do you ship outside the United States?
settings.text: Not yet. HIVOLT currently sells and ships within the United States only.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.text: Every order has 60 days from delivery to return, for any reason. Returns are free — once your return is approved we send a prepaid return label, and there is no restocking fee. Email support@hivolt-usa.com with your order number to start a return.

settings.title: When will I receive my refund?
settings.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of your return reaching us. Depending on your bank, it can take a further 5–10 days to appear on your statement.

settings.title: How do I track my order?
settings.text: Every order is tracked. Use our Track Your Order page with your order number.

settings.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.text: Checkout runs on Shopify's secure checkout. Cards are accepted, along with Shop Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Any applicable sales tax is shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Do I need an account to order?
settings.text: No — guest checkout is available. Creating an account simply keeps your orders in one place.

settings.title: How do I contact HIVOLT?
settings.text: Email support@hivolt-usa.com, call +1 914-650-2041, or use our contact page.
